_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 answers for the Unlearn tenant (PR 1852). Safeguards map to instances/unlearn/runway.json; read by foundation/seedlife.py.

budget.how: runway.json ai-cost: AI_DAILY_CAP and library fallback; abuse cap 30 writes per source per day

dependencies.how: runway.json dependency-drift: zero npm dependencies, pinned compatibility_date

models.how: runway.json model-retired: moves come from the library with no model; re-wording is optional

health.how: the watchdog fetches the verify URL every pass; a failing reading reopens Q-SEED and the handoff closer rolls back

improvement.how: hourly beat re-learns move weights by Beta sampling on 14-day outcomes and opens the next phase when its gates hold

privacy.how: runway.json child-data and storage-growth: no child accounts before phase 3 prerequisites; retention prunes text after 400 days. Phase 3 needs a controller entity (owner_only unlearn-controller-entity, default: phase 3 stays closed)
